Blast at Kaushambi Firecracker Factory Kills 11

An explosion at a firecracker factory in Kaushambi has resulted in the deaths of 11 people. Initial reports indicate 8 fatalities and 20 injuries, with fears that the death toll could rise as more individuals may be trapped under the debris. Rescue operations were ongoing late into the night, with machines reportedly still operating.
